(2) file-tree.md: All M7 test files added across VideoIndexer.Tests/, VideoIndexer.App.Tests/, and VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests/; stale 'no unit tests (test backlog)' annotations removed from CategoryEditorViewModel, TagEditorViewModel, and GrantsManagementViewModel entries. (3) constraints.md: Already contained all required M7 content (ExpectedRevision=40, m040 rollback, NULL uniqueness limitation, TaggerViewModel lifecycle rules, MovieEditorViewModel.LoadAsync single-call invariant, DetectTags partial-implementation note) — no changes needed. (4) data-flows.md: Already contained Section 11 'Tagger Tag-Toggle Flow (M7)' and EnsureLoadedAsync note in shell auth flow — no changes needed. (5) filter-management-specification.md: Already documented effective-set semantics for TagsWeight/AmountTags and introduced StoredTagsWeight/AmountStoredTags — no changes needed. (6) docs/agents/implementation-history/m7-tagging-core.md: Created — milestone synthesis document covering all 26 WPs, metrics (758 tests, schema 39→40, ~145 new tests, 2 security audits), WP-021 rework detail, reviewer fix-forwards, known debt items, and next-steps recommendations for the Planner.
